name: Missing Termination
hint: The termination condition in the block [sbi]repeat until < >[/sbi] is missing. Scratch uses the default value FALSE there. Therefore, this code block will result in an infinite loop.
instruction: Do you want an infinite loop in that position?[newLine]Case yes: Use the [sbi]forever[/sbi] code block. (light error)[newLine]Case no: Insert a suitable termination condition. (hard error)

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
repeat until < > :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
play sound (BumBum v) until done
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever :: #007000 //⇦  👍
play sound (BumBum v) until done
end
